method split_words(txt: string) returns (result: seq<string> | result != null)
    requires txt != null
    ensures (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] != null) // all elements in result are not null
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] != "")) // no empty strings in result if non-empty
    ensures (|result| == 0 ==> (count_lowercase_odd(txt) == 0)) // if result is empty, count of lowercase odd letters should be 0
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> (exists c: char :: c in result)) // result must contain characters if not empty
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> (forall w: string :: w in result ==> w.Split(" ") != result)) // result should not be the same as splitting on spaces

method count_lowercase_odd(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == CountOddLowercaseLetters(txt) // count of lowercase letters with odd order in the alphabet
```
